primitives.asks: Is this entitlement exercised, or held?

branches.label: Exercised
branches.test: the entitlement is taken up by an action the holder performs - a claim, a booking, an access, a draw-down

branches.label: Held
branches.test: the entitlement is a standing protection or permission with nothing to do unless something happens
